subject.title: feat(diagnostics-otel): identify each instance with service.instance.id

question: Should diagnostics-otel accept `OTEL_SERVICE_INSTANCE_ID` plus hostname fallback as a new OpenClaw telemetry identity contract, or should this PR be redirected to the canonical resource-identity seam in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/93071?
rationale: The remaining blocker is not only code shape: it chooses a collector-visible identity source, env precedence, uniqueness/privacy behavior, and whether OpenClaw should add a parallel env knob instead of using standard OTel resource attributes.

options.title: Use Canonical Resource Identity
options.body: Redirect the PR to the canonical issue plan: standard resource attributes, a maintainer-approved unique opaque instance source, docs, and final exported-resource proof.

options.title: Adopt New Env Contract
options.body: Accept `OTEL_SERVICE_INSTANCE_ID` only if maintainers explicitly document precedence, privacy expectations, fallback behavior, and upgrade impact for all signals.

options.title: Pause This Branch
options.body: Keep the PR paused until the stable `service.instance.id` source and preloaded-SDK behavior are decided in the canonical issue.

recommendation.title: Use Canonical Resource Identity
recommendation.body: Redirect the PR to the canonical issue plan: standard resource attributes, a maintainer-approved unique opaque instance source, docs, and final exported-resource proof.

likelyOwner.reason: `bek91` owns the open canonical resource-identity issue and has adjacent diagnostics trace-correlation history, making them the best available routing owner for this product/API choice.
